title: R9 five-case paired engineering-decision comparison
disclosure: Project-authored tasks; deterministic solver outcomes were inspected before model-arm runs. This is exploratory paired evidence, not an externally held-out generalization test.
physical_tool: open_ended_structural_discovery_engine.evaluate; mesh 16 coarse, 48 fine; four thickness/modulus corners; all arms use the same scaled two-stage graph family
candidate_space: uniform thickness 0.6 to 1.0 mm in 0.1 mm steps
action_budget: At most one corrective action after first nominal fine pass with failed uncertainty corner; that action may use at most six additional FEA evaluations. Deterministic uniform fallback remains available and is attributed separately.

arms.B: Muse cold parser, uniform thickness sweep
arms.C: Muse cold parser, one Muse-selected corrective action, attributed uniform fallback
arms.D: Muse cold parser, one Muse action with retrieved CASM context, attributed uniform fallback
arms.E: Deterministic parser, one predeclared rule-selected corrective action, attributed uniform fallback

deterministic_action_rule: If first failed uncertainty corner includes absolute_drift, choose outer_plus_0p1; otherwise choose uniform_plus_0p1. No task-specific tuning after outcomes.
clarification: For G05, a scripted operator supplies the frozen answer '4 N' to every arm that requests force. Other or extra questions count as clarification errors.
claims: Report task-level paired observations only; no significance or Muse superiority claim from five project-authored cases. CASM retrieval is prompt context, not an independently validated new physics engine.
